reason: Checked against src/render.6502 and build/strykers.lst. (1) .cell is reached only by fall-through from STA d_ptr+1: the only references to draw_column.* elsewhere are the operand labels (kindcache, sky_main), .each from ren_draw_sprite; no other JMP/BRA/BCS into .cell (the other .cell labels are different scopes). (2) Carry: LDA col_ptr+1 ; ADC #&FF gives C=1 whenever col_ptr+1 >= 1 whatever the carry in. col_ptr+1 is straight_sprite_hi,X, tested non-zero by BNE known (zero entries return), sprites in ANDY &8000-&8FFF, and col_ptr+1 is only ever INCed (lines 1672, 1709) so it never wraps to 0. STA/TYA leave C, so SBC rows_m1 sees C=1 as after SEC; same A, Z, N, V; both exits unchanged. D flag is clear (SED only in timer code, CLD before exit; IRQ clears D on 65C02 anyway); the carry-out of ADC #&FF is the binary one. (3) Bytes: SEC (1 byte) removed, NOP (1 byte) added after the cold-path SEC, before .data_same_page: net 0, every later address unchanged (BCS data_same_page now skips DEC zp (2) + SEC (1) + NOP (1) = 4 bytes: BCS data_same_page offset goes 3 to 4, in range). Opcodes all real 65C02 (NOP, SEC, SBC zp). (4) Page crossings: draw_column cell test and byte loop sit in page &9C (old: .cell &9C2A, .byte &9C34, BPL byte &9C44, BCS last_cell &9C2E -> &9C77, BRA byte &9C75, .data_same_page &9C51). New: code from SBC to the cold SEC is 1 byte lower (.byte &9C33, BPL byte &9C43, mask_operand/pix_operand 1 lower), all still in page &9C, so BPL byte, BRA byte, BCS last_cell, BCS data_same_page stay same-page (no +1 before or after); BCS last_cell distance 0x48 and BRA byte back 0x44, within range. No indexed table read or branch after the NOP moves. (5) Self-modifying code: mask_operand/pix_operand(_2) are labels (name = * + 1) and every writer (render.6502 1503-1526, kindcache, sky_main) uses draw_column.<label>, so they follow the shift; no hard-coded addresses into the moved bytes. (6) Cycles: hot path saves SEC = 2 cycles per cell entry, 9.4 entries a pass = 18.8 cycles; cold path (DEC/SEC executed ~0.18 times a pass) gains a NOP 2 cycles = 0.36; net about 18.4 a pass, which matches the claim; per execution on the hot path 2.
